content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial permits a formal appeal, while retroactive authorization is no longer available and the payer does not offer peer-to-peer review. The codes and billing order are valid, and submitting records has already failed to resolve the denial. A medical-necessity appeal remains a viable payer path, supported by payment in 12 of 25 similar claims, so it should precede patient billing, write-off, or escalation.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
